artifact_digest_algorithm.scope: The 31-path CP-01 precommit allowlist excluding exactly docs/review/piko-std-canonical-promotion-evidence.json, leaving 30 artifacts.
artifact_digest_algorithm.ordering: Ascending lexicographic order of UTF-8 path bytes
artifact_digest_algorithm.content_digest: SHA-256 over exact file bytes, rendered as 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters
artifact_digest_algorithm.record_format: content_sha256_hex + two ASCII spaces + repository_relative_path_utf8 + LF
artifact_digest_algorithm.record_separator: Each record includes exactly one trailing LF byte; no other separator, prefix, suffix, or final extra blank line.
artifact_digest_algorithm.set_digest: SHA-256 over the concatenation of all 30 record byte strings
artifact_digest_algorithm.recompute_command: python3 -c 'import hashlib,json; from pathlib import Path; ep="docs/review/piko-std-canonical-promotion-evidence.json"; e=json.loads(Path(ep).read_text(encoding="utf-8")); raw=e["precommit_gate"]["changed_files"]; assert len(raw)==31 and len(set(raw))==31 and ep in raw; ps=sorted((p for p in raw if p!=ep),key=lambda p:p.encode("utf-8")); assert len(ps)==30 and all(Path(p).is_file() and not Path(p).is_symlink() for p in ps); manifest=b"".join(hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode("ascii")+b"  "+p.encode("utf-8")+b"\n" for p in ps); print(hashlib.sha256(manifest).hexdigest())'
